courses.title: Deep Neural Networks
courses.description:
- **Textbook:** Zhang, Lipton, Li & Smola, *Dive into Deep Learning* (2023)
- **Mid-sem syllabus:** up to CNN (chapters 1–6); EC-2, closed book (done)
- **Exam:** EC-3 comprehensive, **5 Dec 2026**
- **Format:** open book · all topics

chapters.title: Convolutional Neural Networks
chapters.blurb: Convolution, padding, stride, pooling, parameters, ResNet and transfer learning.

chapters.title: Attention Mechanism
chapters.blurb: Context bottleneck, Q-K-V, scaled dot product, Bahdanau, self/cross/masked/multi-head, positional encoding.

chapters.title: Recurrent Neural Networks
chapters.blurb: Sequences, BPTT, vanishing gradients, GRU and LSTM.

chapters.title: Optimizers
chapters.blurb: Momentum, Nesterov, AdaGrad, RMSprop, Adam/AdamW, schedules, clipping and tuning.

chapters.title: Transformers
chapters.blurb: Encoder and decoder blocks, parameter counts, ViT, BERT/GPT/T5 families, fine-tuning.

chapters.title: Deep Feedforward Networks
chapters.blurb: Hidden layers, activations, forward pass and backpropagation by hand.

chapters.title: Introduction to Deep Learning
chapters.blurb: What DL is, why now, and the four parts of every learning problem.

chapters.title: Artificial Neuron & Perceptron
chapters.blurb: From biological neurons to the perceptron rule, logic gates and XOR.

chapters.title: Linear Neural Networks for Regression
chapters.blurb: One neuron that answers "how much": squared loss and batch gradient descent.

chapters.title: Linear Neural Networks for Classification
chapters.blurb: Sigmoid + BCE with SGD, softmax + cross-entropy with mini-batches, metrics.

chapters.label: Mid-sem · EC-2R
chapters.title: Mid-Semester, Mar 2026
chapters.blurb: Closed book, 30 marks. Metrics, perceptron network, backprop, GD + normal equations, overfitting.

chapters.label: Comprehensive · EC-3R
chapters.title: Comprehensive, May 2026
chapters.blurb: Open book, 40 marks. Exploding gradients, domain shift, attention, scaling, conv filters, momentum.

chapters.label: Mid-sem · 2023 regular
chapters.title: Mid-Semester 2023-24 (Regular)
chapters.blurb: NOR perceptron, Boolean MLP, 6-input XOR, BCE derivative, ReLU graph, learning-rate bounds.

chapters.label: Mid-sem · 2023 makeup
chapters.title: Mid-Semester 2023-24 (Makeup)
chapters.blurb: Perceptron epoch, CCE derivative, rectangle MLP, GD, sigmoid graph, cubic surface.

chapters.label: End-sem · 2023 makeup
chapters.title: End-Semester 2023-24 (Makeup)
chapters.blurb: LeNet+RNN captioner, multi-head shapes, NiN params, Keras CNN fill-in, GRU params.

groupIntros.Exam hall: Past papers, solved step by step. Your next exam: **EC-3 comprehensive, 5 Dec 2026** (open book).

courses.title: Introduction to Statistical Methods
courses.description:
- **Textbooks:** T1 Kaptein et al., *Statistics for Data Scientists*; T2 Devore, *Probability and Statistics for Engineering and the Sciences*; T3 Brockwell & Davis, *Introduction to Time Series and Forecasting*
- **Exam:** EC-3 comprehensive
- **Format:** open book · 40% of the course
- **Pre-mid syllabus:** CS 1–7 (up to module 7; CS 8 is the review), roughly 10–15% of end-sem marks; the rest comes from CS 9 onwards

chapters.title: Hypothesis Testing
chapters.blurb: H₀/H₁, errors, p-values, z and t tests, proportions, paired data, chi-square.

chapters.title: Correlation & Regression
chapters.blurb: Covariance, Pearson r, autocovariance and autocorrelation, PCA. Regression line, r², Spearman, and every past-paper question type.

chapters.title: Smoothing & Time-series Models
chapters.blurb: Simple exponential smoothing (worked), videos, and a red pending board for Holt, moving averages and SARIMA to VARMAX.

chapters.title: Maximum Likelihood & ANOVA
chapters.blurb: MLE for Bernoulli, Binomial, Poisson and Normal, F-test for two variances, one-way and two-way ANOVA.

chapters.title: Prediction & Forecasting
chapters.blurb: Trend, seasonality, moving averages.

chapters.title: Conditional & Total Probability
chapters.blurb: Conditioning, independence, the law of total probability.

chapters.title: Gaussian Mixture Models & EM
chapters.blurb: Soft clustering, mixtures of Gaussians, expectation-maximisation.

chapters.title: Descriptive Statistics
chapters.blurb: Central tendency, spread, skew, outliers, five-number summary.

chapters.title: Random Variables
chapters.blurb: Discrete and continuous, expectation, variance, joint distributions.

chapters.title: Sampling & Estimation
chapters.blurb: Sampling distributions, CLT, point and interval estimation.

chapters.title: Bayes' Theorem & Naïve Bayes
chapters.blurb: Bayes with proof, Naïve Bayes classification, Laplace smoothing.

chapters.title: Probability Basics
chapters.blurb: Axioms, addition rule, mutually exclusive vs independent events.

chapters.title: Probability Distributions
chapters.blurb: Bernoulli, Binomial, Poisson, Normal; t, F and χ² introduced.

chapters.title: Time Series Models
chapters.blurb: AR, MA, ARMA, ARIMA.

courses.title: Mathematical Foundations for Machine Learning
courses.description:
- **Textbooks:** T1 Deisenroth, Faisal & Ong, *Mathematics for Machine Learning*; T2 Aggarwal, *Linear Algebra and Optimization*
- **Reference books:** R1 Hoffman & Kunze, *Linear Algebra*; R2 Kreyszig, *Advanced Engineering Mathematics*
- **Pre-mid syllabus:** lectures 1–8 (up to module 8) (linear algebra, decompositions, vector calculus): 35–45% of the end-sem marks. Do not skip them.
- **Lectures not written yet: read first, video only if stuck** (Lectures 9, 11–16 have this inside the card):
| Lectures | Needs first | Read first (slides + Sourabh sir) | One video, only if stuck |
| L1–2 Linear systems, rank, basis | nothing | `Lecture_1.pdf`, `Lecture_2.pdf`; `Lecture_1_Companion`, `Lecture_2_Companion`; P1–P6 | [Column space and null space](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uQhTuRlWMxw) |
| L4–5 Eigenvalues, SVD | Ax = 0 (L1–2) | `Lecture_4.pdf`, `Lecture_5.pdf`; `Lecture_4_Companion`, `Lecture_5_Companion`; P12–P18 | [Eigenvectors and eigenvalues](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PFDu9oVAE-g); SVD only if stuck: [SVD overview](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gXbThCXjZFM) |
| L3 Inner products, Gram–Schmidt | leading minors (L4) | `Lecture_3.pdf` p. 4–9, 13–25; `Lecture_3_Companion`; P7–P11 | [Gram–Schmidt (Oxford)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RoI0InFNVSs) |
| L6–8 Vector calculus | school derivatives | `Lecture_6.pdf`–`Lecture_8.pdf`; `Lecture_6_Companion`, `Lecture_7_Companion`, `lecture_8_Companion`; P19–P25 | [Positive definite and minima](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cfn2ZUuWPd0) (the Hessian test) |
| L11, L14 Lagrange, KKT | gradient (L6–8) | `Lecture_11.pdf` p. 20–34; `Lecture_14.pdf` p. 3–11; `Lagrange-KKT-Duality-Practice-Set`; P35–P39 | [Visualizing KKT](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yDMlNumgZ9E) |

chapters.group: On the day of the exam
chapters.label: Checklist + cheat sheet
chapters.title: On the day of the exam
chapters.blurb: Quick checks and rules collected while studying, plus a printable cheat sheet. Read it the evening before and once more before the paper.

chapters.label: Lecture 11
chapters.title: Momentum, Adam & Constrained Optimisation
chapters.blurb: Momentum, AdaGrad, RMSProp, Adam (p. 2–19); constrained optimisation, Lagrangian, primal and dual, convexity, LP, QP (p. 20–34). 20 solved problems. Before: gradient descent (Lecture 9).

chapters.label: Lecture 2
chapters.title: Vector Spaces, Independence, Basis & Rank
chapters.blurb: Linear (in)dependence, span, basis, dimension, rank, subspaces. Before: Gaussian elimination (Lecture 1).

chapters.label: Lecture 14
chapters.title: KKT, Hyperplanes, Kernel Functions & the SVM Primal
chapters.blurb: Lagrangian, duality, KKT conditions (p. 3–11); hyperplane, kernel functions, linear classifier, the hard-margin primal (p. 12–24). Question models M1, M6, M7. Before: dot product and norm (Lecture 3); Lagrangian (Lecture 11).

chapters.label: Lecture 15
chapters.title: Solving the SVM: Dual & Soft Margin
chapters.blurb: The dual, support vectors, soft margin, slack, hinge loss, the effect of C. Question models M2–M5. Before: Lecture 14.

chapters.label: Lecture 9
chapters.title: Gradient Descent & Line Search
chapters.blurb: Loss, the GD rule, step size, learning-rate decay, exact and golden-section / binary line search, SGD. Before: gradient (Lecture 6), Hessian (Lecture 8).

chapters.label: Lecture 3
chapters.title: Norms, Inner Products & Gram–Schmidt
chapters.blurb: Norms, inner product from a symmetric positive-definite matrix, length, angle, orthogonality, orthonormal basis, Gram–Schmidt. Before: dot product; leading minors (Lecture 4).

chapters.label: Lecture 4
chapters.title: Determinant, Eigenvalues & Cholesky
chapters.blurb: Determinant and trace, characteristic polynomial, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, spectral theorem, Cholesky. Before: solving Ax = 0 (Lectures 1–2).

chapters.label: Lecture 5
chapters.title: Eigendecomposition & SVD
chapters.blurb: Diagonalisation (PDP⁻¹, QΛQᵀ, powers), the SVD by hand for 2 × 2, 3 × 2 and 2 × 3 matrices, rank-k approximation and the spectral norm, EVD vs SVD. Types 1–4, 20 solved problems. Before: eigenvalues (Lecture 4).

weight.note: 4 of the 10 papers overall (also previous batch Q4: 5 marks, 2022 Q2(b): 4 marks)

chapters.label: Lecture 13
chapters.title: PCA in Practice
chapters.blurb: Reduce and reconstruct, a new point, choosing M, wide data (D ≫ N), the SVD route and Eckart–Young, power iteration and reasoning questions. Types 3–6, 12 solved problems. Before: Lecture 12.

chapters.label: Lecture 6
chapters.title: Partial Derivatives & Gradients
chapters.blurb: Partial differentiation, gradients, gradients of vector-valued functions, chain rule.

chapters.label: Lecture 8
chapters.title: Hessian, Taylor Series & Extrema
chapters.blurb: Hessian matrix, Taylor's series in two variables, mean-value theorem, maxima and minima. Before: gradients (Lecture 6).

chapters.label: Lecture 12
chapters.title: PCA: Maximum Variance
chapters.blurb: Why PCA chases variance (with an interactive line), the full PCA recipe by hand, and the Lagrangian proof that PC1 is the top eigenvector. Types 1–2, 13 solved problems. Before: eigenvalues (Lecture 4).

weight.note: Practice Paper Q5: 6 marks; PCA got 10 marks in each older paper

chapters.label: Lecture 1
chapters.title: Solution of Linear Systems
chapters.blurb: Systems of equations, augmented matrix, Gaussian elimination, unique / infinite / no solution.

chapters.label: Lecture 16
chapters.title: Nonlinear SVM: the Kernel Trick
chapters.blurb: Expert lecture, no slides. Kernel SVM on data no line separates (model M8). Before: kernel functions (Lecture 14), the dual (Lecture 15).

weight.note: Practice Paper Q7: 5 marks; 10 marks in the 2023 papers

chapters.label: Lecture 7
chapters.title: Backpropagation & Automatic Differentiation
chapters.blurb: Chain rule through a computation graph, backpropagation. Before: gradients (Lecture 6).

chapters.label: Lecture 10
chapters.title: Optimisation in Practice
chapters.blurb: Local optima and flat regions, differential curvature, feature normalisation, overfitting. Before: gradient descent (Lecture 9).

chapters.label: End-sem · Feb 2026 regular
chapters.title: Comprehensive, Feb 2026 (Regular)
chapters.blurb: Eigenvalues and diagonalisation, rank and determinant, inner product + KKT, Hessian and GD with decay, hard-margin SVM.

chapters.label: End-sem · Mar 2026 makeup
chapters.title: Comprehensive, Mar 2026 (Makeup)
chapters.blurb: Eigenspace, Gram–Schmidt, binary-search line search, momentum, PCA, soft-margin hinge loss.

chapters.label: End-sem · Sep 2025 regular
chapters.title: Comprehensive, Sep 2025 (Regular)
chapters.blurb: Rank and column space, SVD and covariance, chain rule + dual, momentum vs GD, hinge loss of two models, (1 + xz)² kernel matrix.

chapters.label: End-sem · Sep 2024 regular
chapters.title: Comprehensive, Sep 2024 (Regular)
chapters.blurb: Older 4 × 10 style. General solution and skew-symmetric matrices, SVM dual + kernel map + momentum average, PCA + power method, backprop graph.

chapters.label: End-sem · Sep 2024 makeup
chapters.title: Comprehensive, Sep 2024 (Makeup)
chapters.blurb: Older 4 × 10 style. 10-mark KKT signal tower, cubic + GD zone of attraction, PCA, soft-margin C, echelon form and subspaces.

chapters.title: Comprehensive, 2023 (Regular, Apr 2024)
chapters.blurb: Older 4 × 10 style, no key. Find β from momentum iterates, Cholesky, kernel trick on 1-D data, null space, sigmoid gradient, PCA on four points.

chapters.title: Comprehensive, previous batch (about Apr 2023)
chapters.blurb: Scanned online paper, 9 short questions, no key. SVM dual add-a-point (asked again in Sep 2024), Gaussian elimination, SVD, PCA under rotation, AM–GM by Lagrange, convex sets, a quadratic form.

chapters.title: Comprehensive, 2022 (Makeup)
chapters.blurb: Oldest style, 4 × 10. Quartic minima, PCA direction, KKT check, five short linear-algebra proofs, XᵀX trick, exact line search, GD on a parabola, kernel feature map.
